content: स्तम्भनम् [स्तम्भयति स्तम्भ्-णिच् ल्युट्] .²1 Stopping, obstructing, hindering, arresting, suppressing, restraining; लोलोल्लोलक्षुभितकरणोज्जृम्भणस्तम्भनार्थम् <ls>U. 3. 36</ls>. .²2 Paralysing, benumbing, stupefying. .²3 Quieting, composure; पराङ्मुखेऽपि दैवेऽत्र कृत्यं कार्यं विपश्चिता . आत्मदोषविनाशाय खचित्तस्तम्भनाय च .. <ls>Pt. 1. 360</ls>. .²4 Making firm or stiff, fixing firmly. .²5 Propping, supporting. .²6 Stopping the flow of blood. .²7 Anything employed as an astringent. .²8 A particular magical art or faculty; see स्तम्भ (10). .{@-नः@} <ab>N.</ab> of one of the five arrows of Cupid.
